text: Unit tests: `uv run pytest tests/unit -q`. Integration tests need `docker compose up -d db`, then `uv run pytest tests/integration`.
Money is Decimal everywhere, never float. API responses carry amounts as strings like "12.30" so JS clients don't lose precision.
Invoice rounding rule agreed with finance: round each line item to the currency's decimals with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, then sum. Never round only the total.
The Decimal context (precision 28, ROUND_HALF_EVEN) is set in src/meterly/billing/rounding.py. Don't create ad-hoc decimal.Context objects elsewhere.
Billing math has Hypothesis property tests in tests/unit/billing/. When one fails, commit the printed @example(...) as a regression case.
JPY and KRW have zero decimal places. Use currency_exponent(code) from billing/currency.py instead of assuming 2 dp.
Invoices are immutable once status=finalized. Corrections are new credit-note invoices, never edits to existing line items.
Invoice totals are computed as floats and rounded with round(total, 2) at the end.
Dependencies use pip-tools: edit requirements.in and run pip-compile.
Dependencies are managed with uv (`uv add`, `uv sync`); the requirements files are gone.
Usage events are ingested by the Kafka consumer in src/meterly/ingest/consumer.py; offsets are committed only after the DB write.
Backfill usage for a tenant with `uv run meterly backfill --tenant <slug> --from <date>`; it is throttled to 500 events/s.
API keys are hashed with argon2 in the auth module; the plaintext is shown once at creation and never stored.
ruff does formatting and linting (`uv run ruff format`, `uv run ruff check --fix`); line length is 100.
Branch prefixes are feat/, fix/ and chore/. Reference the MTR- ticket in the PR description.
Local server: `uv run fastapi dev src/meterly/main.py` on port 8000; OpenAPI docs at /docs.
Money fields in Pydantic response schemas use the MoneyStr type from src/meterly/api/types.py, which serializes Decimal as a string.
Rate limiting for the public API happens at the edge proxy, not in the app; don't add slowapi or similar middleware.
Grafana dashboards for ingest lag are provisioned from ops/grafana/*.json; edit the JSON, not the UI.
Alembic: `uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m <msg>`, then check the file by hand; autogenerate misses server defaults.
Invoices are generated by the nightly cron script scripts/gen_invoices.py.
Invoice generation runs as the billing.close_period Celery task at period end; the old cron script was deleted.
Tenant data exports (GDPR) are built in src/meterly/exports/ as a zip of CSVs; they leave out invoice PDFs.
Test factories live in tests/factories.py; make_invoice(lines=[...]) builds a draft invoice with line items.
